rationale: The working diagnosis identifies a payer-beneficiary mismatch and commodity pricing for basic passport creation. This redesign preserves the defensible owner-authorised asset identity and lawful lifecycle history, but makes that record free and shifts the paid event to a verified, technician-reviewed service or parts completion. It materially changes five fingerprint fields and removes the subscription and data-API contributions that previously supplied most modeled revenue. The resulting transaction-volume requirement and variable-cost exposure are stated explicitly as unvalidated; no customer adoption, provider commitment, data right, conversion rate, or improved margin is claimed.
